findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - running the full Forge test suite.
The two new entries are copied into the temporary repo by tests/test_required_repo_rules.py:42, but that test creates files only for the four old entries at lines 36–48. src/forge/fasttest.py:843–844 passes the missing files to pytest, so the existing test fails instead of proving selection. The full suite will therefore be red when it runs this test.
findings.title: Keep the required-tests fixture in sync with the new entries

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - the owner splits a fix's P1 Not done finding, narrows its Done-when, and a later review encounters that finding again.
The ruling cites tests/test_split_keeps_review_findings.py, but its findings at lines 54–56 have ordinary defect titles. For a Not done finding, src/forge/close.py:128–137 records the split as a follow-up, while src/forge/review.py:1097–1105 removes that marker when the saved review is classified again. The finding remains required and blocks under review.py:190–196, so the split decision is lost. The owner-approved Done-when is: A change to review code runs the split and review-noise tests in its related-test check, a split's decisions survive a later review, and the missing-tool review-choice skip test passes.
findings.title: Not done: A split's decisions survive a later review

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - reviewing the evidence for this fix.
The supplied proof list is missing. There is no worker mapping identifying the checks for related-test selection, the later review after a split, and the missing-tool skip case.
findings.title: Gate: proof list

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a later review-code change runs the related-test check.
No command-level test verifies that both newly required files are selected. The existing test at tests/test_required_repo_rules.py:36–48 asserts only the four older entries; if both new lines were removed, its expected receipts would be unchanged. Extend the selection proof so it fails when either required file is omitted.
findings.title: Gate: related-test selection of the split and review-noise tests

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate
Adds work: recording the client-repository effects; F 1 x H 1 = 1; 2 x C = 2
The branch explanation does not say what a newly initialized or adopted client repository receives, or what an existing repository receives on upgrade, as the repository's review rule requires. The changes appear confined to Forge's own test list and test fixture; state that outcome for both cases.
findings.title: Gate: state what new and existing client repositories receive

findings.body:
Gain 1, Work 1, Harm 1
Adds work: recording the three approach lines; F 1 x H 1 = 1; 2 x C = 2
The branch has no before-coding lines for the need, simplest option, and existing code reused. Recording them would make the choice to extend the repository-owned test list explicit.
findings.title: Simpler: infer the approach from the patch → record the choices

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round

why: A change to review code can pass its own related-test check while the split and review-noise tests fail, which turned main red twice on 16 Nov 2026; a split's decisions may also be lost when a later review runs, and one review-choice skip test fails before these changes.
